_comment: Notion pages this skill reads, pinned by ID. Content is fetched live at run time via the Notion MCP, so an edit in Notion reaches the next run with no change here. Only two pages matter to this skill — the rest of Clarity's Notion is irrelevant to a network sweep.
usage: Fetch by page_id with the Notion MCP (notion-fetch, passing page_id as `id`). NEVER search by title — Clarity's workspace holds older duplicates under identical titles, and binding to a stale copy looks like a working run. If a pinned fetch fails, say so and fall back to reference/ranking.md; do not search.
